title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption evolves in a population under social influence, policy interventions, supply constraints, costs, and information campaigns/misinformation.

interactions.name: social_influence_on_attitude
interactions.description: People update pro-mask beliefs and perceived norms based on neighbors' attitudes and observed behaviors.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast_and_response
interactions.description: PolicyMaker announces mandates/campaigns; people update compliance and locations enforce rules.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: People buy masks from Retailers subject to inventory, price, and personal budget.

interactions.name: location_visit_and_enforcement
interactions.description: People visit locations; mask requirements and enforcement affect entry and subsequent behavior.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: MediaChannel messages (campaigns or misinformation) influence beliefs, perceived risk, and trust.

interactions.name: household_norm_reinforcement
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's norms and coordinate mask purchases.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to first reach 70% adoption, if achieved.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration_over_80
metrics.description: Total days with adoption rate at or above 80%.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_gini
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across demographic groups measured by Gini coefficient.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates attributable to mandates/enforcement versus baseline (e.g., pre/post or counterfactual comparison).

metrics.name: average_masks_purchased_per_person
metrics.description: Mean number of masks purchased per person over the simulation.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement actions (e.g., denied entries, fines).

metrics.name: misinformation_exposure_rate
metrics.description: Average rate at which people are exposed to misinformation messages.
